text: Chris Ryan, State Senator – Central New York's Champion Chris Ryan, State Senator – Central New York's Champion Skip to content
Chris Ryan is a State Senator, local union leader, and family man who was born and raised in Central New York.
Chris knows the issues that impact our day-to-day lives, and he works for solutions that will grow our local economy and benefit working families.

Chris Ryan was elected to the State Senate in 2024. He previously served on the Geddes Town Board, as Minority Leader of the Onondaga County Legislature, and as President of Communications Workers of America Local 1123.
His wife, Erin, is a teacher, and they have raised their four children in our public schools.
I'll never ever, ever stop working on behalf of our working men and women in Central New York.
Chris knows the issues that impact our day-to-day lives, and he works for solutions that will grow our local economy and benefit working families.
Chris was instrumental in bringing Micron to Central New York, and he's fighting to ensure the project results in good local jobs.
Chris is married to an educator and committed to delivering the resources our schools need to produce strong students.
Ever since he was a local legislator, Chris has secured significant funding for our law enforcement and emergency services.
Chris took action to lower drug costs by expanding access to affordable medications and increasing lower-cost options.
As President of Communications Workers of America for our region, Chris is passionate about fighting for workers. He has ensured that hundreds of jobs stay here in Central New York.
